title: Virtual Card Management: Revoking and Canceling Virtual Cards
summary: This document explains when to use **Revoke** vs **Cancel** for bank **Virtual Cards**. It provides step-by-step procedures: revoke immediately disables purchases and makes the card unusable within **3 seconds**, while cancel permanently closes the card and blocks authorization within **3 seconds**, followed by refresh/verification and audit recordkeeping.
faqs: When should I choose Revoke vs Cancel for a virtual card?
